company.name: SilkChart
company.shortDescription: AI-powered sales coach for B2B teams
company.description: SilkChart is an AI-powered sales coach that helps reps better understand their clients and win more deals. It analyzes sales calls and provides feedback on how to communicate more effectively, uncover pain points, and personalize solutions based on prospects' needs.

productsAndServices.description: Analyzes sales calls to measure and track how well sales playbooks are executed by individual reps and teams.
productsAndServices.name: SilkChart Playbook Adoption Analysis

productsAndServices.description: Provides AI-generated, specific, and actionable feedback to sales reps immediately after each call to improve sales conversations and playbook execution.
productsAndServices.name: SilkChart AI Sales Coach

productsAndServices.description: Automatically surfaces key calls and reps needing attention, provides alerts on churn risk, forecast risk, sentiment, and competitor mentions, and offers keyword analysis and customizable call summaries.
productsAndServices.name: SilkChart Team Analytics

productsAndServices.description: Automatically records and transcribes sales calls from platforms like Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams without requiring a bot to join the meeting.
productsAndServices.name: SilkChart Automated Call Recording and Transcription

productsAndServices.description: Automatically drafts follow-up emails after sales calls using best practices to save time and maintain consistent communication.
productsAndServices.name: SilkChart AI-Generated Post-Call Emails

productsAndServices.description: Integrates with calendars, meeting platforms, Slack, email, and CRM systems to automate call recording, note-taking, and delivery of insights.
productsAndServices.name: SilkChart CRM and Workflow Integrations

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $5,200,000, or 91.23% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,480,065 to $25,363,126, a 3.91x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 56 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 58 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
